user.title: SPOT Trace History
user.description: Enter your SPOT public XML feed ID and optional feed password.

reconfigure.title: Update feed password
reconfigure.description:
Feed ID: {feed_id}

Enter the current password for this shared SPOT feed, or leave it empty if the feed has none. The feed ID cannot be changed because it identifies this feed's trackers and archived history.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the SPOT feed
error.feed_not_found: SPOT has no feed with this ID. Check the ID of your shared feed.
error.feed_rejected: SPOT rejected the request: {spot_error}. Check the feed password.

manage_devices.title: Manage devices
manage_devices.description: Choose a SPOT device to edit.

device.title: Device settings

abort.no_devices: No SPOT devices have been discovered for this feed yet.
abort.device_not_found: The selected SPOT device could not be found.

import_gpx.name: Import historical SPOT GPX
import_gpx.description: Import an Activity Report GPX and show added, duplicate, and skipped counts in a notification. Optionally returns detailed response data.

filename.name: GPX filename
filename.description: Relative path beneath /config, for example spot_exports/ActivityReport.gpx

feed_id.name: SPOT feed ID
feed_id.description: Optional destination for all tracks. Omit to route tracks across configured feeds.

entry_id.name: Integration entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional alternative to feed ID when importing into a specific configured feed.

device_mapping.name: GPX track-to-device mapping
device_mapping.description: Mapping from GPX track names to messenger IDs. Known IDs can automatically select their configured feeds.

feed_mapping.name: GPX track-to-feed mapping
feed_mapping.description: Optional mapping from GPX track names to configured feed IDs, for unknown or ambiguous devices.

import_sqlite.name: Import SPOT iOS database
import_sqlite.description: Import a SPOT iOS SQLite export and show added, duplicate, and skipped counts in a notification. Optionally returns detailed response data.

filename.name: Database filename
filename.description: Relative path beneath /config. The source is opened read-only; invalid coordinates are skipped.

feed_id.name: SPOT feed ID
feed_id.description: Optional destination for every device. Omit for per-device routing across configured feeds.

entry_id.name: Integration entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional alternative to feed ID for selecting one destination entry.

device_mapping.name: App device-to-messenger mapping
device_mapping.description: Map device names in the iOS database to XML messenger IDs. App database IDs are separate from messenger IDs.

feed_mapping.name: App device-to-feed mapping
feed_mapping.description: Map device names in the iOS database to configured feed IDs for unknown or ambiguous destinations.
